svg.title: How to read the P–H diagram for HFC-134a
svg.text: How to read the P–H (ln P–H) diagram for HFC-134a
Log pressure against enthalpy; saturation dome, isotherms, isentropes and quality lines; redrawn (British units)
Find the pressure on the log scale (here 60 psia) and go across — the dome tells you the phase.
Stop at the isotherm of the given temperature (here 140 °F, superheated vapour, right of the dome).
Go straight down to the enthalpy axis.
Read H ≈ 130.2 Btu/lbm. For compression, follow the isentrope (red) instead of the isotherm.
Inside the dome T is constant along each horizontal line (T_sat); x lines give the vapour fraction. Throttling = vertical line.
Redrawn from tabulated R-134a properties (Çengel Tables A-11 to A-13, −40 °F datum as SVNA Table 9.1); in the exam read the printed chart.
